title: Real party in interest
summary: The real party in interest is the person entitled under the governing substantive law to enforce the right asserted. The inquiry can change when rights are assigned or an insurer becomes subrogated to a claim.
notes: This is distinct from capacity, Article III standing, and permission to join persons. Ellis Canning supplies a state-law example, not the complete federal Rule 17 procedure.

sections.Meaning: The real party in interest is the person entitled under the governing substantive law to enforce the right asserted. The inquiry can change when rights are assigned or an insurer becomes subrogated to a claim.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the underlying right and any transfer or payment affecting who owns it. Distinguish full subrogation from partial payment. Then apply the governing procedural rule about the name in which the action proceeds and any opportunity to cure.
